ariweinstein.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the next frontier is superhuman speed, not model intelligence.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 在多数任务上已超过普通人，下一个前沿是超人速度，而非模型智能本身。

ariweinstein.en: Agents can operate all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, unlocking universal automation beyond API integrations.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体能通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，解锁超越 API 集成的通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use closes the dev lifecycle: agents write JavaScript to batch actions, test and debug their own code autonomously.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 打通开发闭环：智能体写 JavaScript 批量执行动作，并自主测试、调试自己的代码。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to website load time; developers should use OpenAI's harness since models are trained on it.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间；开发者应使用 OpenAI 的 harness，因为模型正是在其上训练的。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials; proactivity means agents adapt to users, not vice versa.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节；主动性意味着智能体适应用户，而非用户适应智能体。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and expertise matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the junior talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、声音与专业能力更有价值，而初级人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and the jagged frontier persists.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面，而锯齿状前沿依然存在。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing work to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so apprenticeship must be rebuilt with formal assessment.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把工作交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此学徒制必须通过正式评估重建。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more work worth attempting.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的指数曲线与采用滞后使人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 降低组织成本，并创造更多值得尝试的工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a challenging tutor, not a crutch; wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste, and agency remain persistent human advantages.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当作有挑战性的导师而非拐杖；广博知识、深厚专业、品味与能动性仍是持久的人类优势。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while human judgment sets the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but doesn't know what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师转变为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类判断设定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不知道什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给 AI 智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, not just design in Figma; ideas, not execution speed, are now the limit.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试、甚至提交 pull request，而不只在 Figma 里设计；如今瓶颈是想法而非执行速度。

marvinschwaibold.en: Curation and human craft matter more as AI-generated animations often add no value; less is more—reduce to top three features.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 生成的动画常无价值，策展与人工手艺更重要；少即是多——把功能精简到前三项。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict people about 85% as accurately as they replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类的准确率约为人类自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model irrational, biased humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral and RCT data close the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据与随机对照试验数据能弥合“说”与“做”的差距。

joonpark.en: Post-training on RCT data lifts behavioral prediction, enabling counterfactual causal testing and shaping the future, not just predicting it.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练可提升行为预测，使反事实因果检验成为可能，从而塑造未来而非仅做预测。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives as a CERN-like social simulator, tackling wicked problems; simulation cost is not the barrier.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是扩展到模拟 80 亿人，打造类似 CERN 的社会模拟器以应对棘手问题；模拟成本并非障碍。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers stay at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，因此人类劳动者反而更稀缺、更受重视。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个注脚；真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration and reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；开源对防止权力集中和奖励黑客至关重要。

andreessen.en: AI creates the biggest-ever gap between early adopters and laggards; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket.
andreessen.zh: AI 在早期采用者与落后者之间制造了史上最大差距；个人比机构采用更快，因此创业潮将暴涨。

andreessen.en: New media makes the person the brand; authenticity beats old media's defense, and picking fights builds brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让个人成为品牌；真实胜过旧媒体的防守姿态，选对对手开战反而能塑造品牌。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value for others.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调减少无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，意义应来自关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked, so deploy iteratively and let society adapt. Compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从 RLHF 让小数据即可对齐出发，提出对齐与能力相互促进，主张迭代部署让社会适应；同时判断算力将成为最稀缺的商品，需要大规模投入。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge, and safety must be built iteratively through deployment rather than imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长但体感渐进；智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，安全必须通过部署迭代构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and increasingly underdefined; the goal shifts to superintelligence, with compute as profit center and personal AGI that knows your context.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为渐变且定义模糊，目标转向超级智能；算力从成本变为利润中心，方向是懂你上下文的个人 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment is not solved; pause frontier training if the safety case fails, keep humans in control, and distribute power widely rather than concentrate it.
altman.zh: 2026 年他深化为：对齐尚未解决，安全论证不成立就暂停前沿训练，必须确保人类掌控，并把权力与收益广泛分布而非集中。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability drive breakthroughs; production, not prototyping, is the hard bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与完全可复用是突破的关键，并指出量产比原型更难，真正的瓶颈在制造。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; AI programmed to lie is the core danger.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他对 AI 安全的论述从依赖监管转向强调追求真相，认为让 AI 说谎才是核心危险。

elon.en: Civilization risk reframes around population collapse, government fraud, and voter import, alongside AI existential risk.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把文明风险重新聚焦到人口崩溃、政府欺诈与选民输入上，同时保留 AI 生存风险。

elon.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; abundance, deflation, and optional work replace scarcity economics.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能将在数年内到来，丰裕、通缩与可选工作取代稀缺经济学。

elon.en: Compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing inference and data centers to space; humans likely lose control of AI.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为算力撞上地球电力墙，推理与数据中心转向太空，人类很可能失去对 AI 的控制。

sundarpichai.en: AI investments now redefine every Alphabet business, with Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, and YouTube driving 24% revenue growth.
sundarpichai.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 投资已重新定义 Alphabet 的每块业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube，推动 24%的营收增长。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to sustain frontier research.
sundarpichai.zh: 算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支撑前沿研究而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱隔离，以及与独立评估方共建的行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models matter as much as LLMs for intelligence; Google pursues both paths toward AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 对智能而言，世界模型与大语言模型同等重要；谷歌同时推进两条通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

sundarpichai.en: We are early in the most consequential technology; demand for compute far exceeds supply, and recursive self-improvement still keeps researchers in the loop.
sundarpichai.zh: 我们仍处在这项最具影响力技术的早期；算力需求远超供给，而递归自我改进目前仍把研究者留在回路中。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, while universities should foster interaction.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能规模化实现掌握式学习，而大学应聚焦互动而非广播内容。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped reinforcement learning and AGI fears.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；从小项目起步建设组织 AI 能力，重视监督学习，而非被高估的强化学习与 AGI 焦虑。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver practical value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正落地价值来自智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI automates tasks not jobs, so learning to code and building with AI remain essential.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 自动化的是任务而非岗位，因此学编程与用 AI 构建仍不可或缺。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign AI; fear-mongering and export controls serve incumbents and harm US competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保留选择权与主权 AI；恐惧叙事与出口管制服务于既得利益者，反而损害美国竞争力。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center is the new unit of computing, built through extreme co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：规模下性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元，需通过极端协同设计整体构建。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—mean inference compute demand grows a billion times; scaling itself was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年明确三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考——推理算力需求将增长十亿倍；真正的突破不是新算法，而是 Scaling（规模扩张）本身有效。

jensen.en: AI moves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing 100x more compute; four scaling laws all bounded by compute, not data.
jensen.zh: 2026 年将 AI 演进分为生成式→推理→智能体式，每步需百倍算力；四条缩放定律最终都受算力而非数据约束，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; AI factories manufacture intelligence tokens like dynamos make electricity.
jensen.zh: 2026 年系统化为「五层蛋糕」：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；AI 工厂像发电机产出电力一样生产智能 token，是新的制造业。

jensen.en: Doom warnings are unscientific fear-mongering; AI is just software. Safety comes from containment, monitoring, and self-regulation—not slowdown or new rules.
jensen.zh: 2026 年立场激化：末日警告是不科学的恐吓，AI 只是软件；安全靠遏制、监控与企业自律，而非放缓或新监管，完美对齐不可能。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise needs its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他把 AI 重新定义为“企业的未来”而非单纯技术：每家企业都要建自己的爬坡机器，用私有评测持续复利“token 资本”，而不是把 AI 交给 IT 部门。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems.
satya.zh: 同期他提出私有评测可能比模型或数据更值钱，是最大的 IP；并强调别用前沿模型解决非前沿问题，以追求 token 效率。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他把重心转向智能体时代：TAM 将比云大几个数量级，微软要做前沿生态而非只做前沿模型，定价也转向席位加用量混合。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 他承认缩放定律有效，但明确对齐不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化反而可能妨碍对齐——这是对早期乐观的修正。

satya.en: Alignment may never be solved; treat powerful models as insider threats and lock them down with external control layers.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月进一步深化：对齐也许永远无解，应把强模型当内部威胁，在模型外建控制与保证层；并称“超级智能”比 AGI 更准确，落后前沿六个月是明智策略。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills, though gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他强调设计是软件的核心差异化，并预判 AI 会融合角色、让人人成为具备设计能力的产品构建者；但对既有代码库，AI 的生产力提升其实有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design judgment.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年春，他把重心转向品味、手艺与观点：AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词，人的判断仍是最终裁决。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年夏，他反驳“设计已死”，认为设计对可扩展的真实系统更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，交互也将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the floor but not the ceiling, and humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年秋，他明确提出“设计是新的代码”：AI 降低下限却不抬高上限，上限由人类以大胆创意和观点抬升。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human taste and judgment stay central, differentiation shifts to design and brand, and AI should expand rather than replace human thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人的品味与判断始终居中，差异化转向设计与品牌，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆，是后训练阶段智能体式数据的新前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; evals are the real bottleneck because RL saturates them fast.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法；真正的瓶颈是评测，因为强化学习会迅速把评测刷满。

brendanfoody.en: Humans must build verifiers and rubrics; models cannot reliably grade their own work, limiting recursive self-improvement.
brendanfoody.zh: 人类必须构建验证器与评分标准；模型无法可靠地给自己打分，这限制了递归自我改进。

brendanfoody.en: Creating training data and evals will be the last human job, as people shift to training agents.
brendanfoody.zh: 创造训练数据与评测将是人类最后的工作，人们会转向训练智能体。

brendanfoody.en: Next shift is ultra-long-horizon RL tasks and virtual co-workers; physical-world superintelligence will take decades.
brendanfoody.zh: 下一步是超长周期 RL 任务与虚拟同事；物理世界的超级智能还需数十年。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三件套，认为三者都自持才算真正拥有智能；主线是控制权，而非单点能力。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 同年他强调智能体失败多因上下文没喂对、而非模型不行，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要——这是对“模型不够强”叙事的持续反驳。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but customization is shifting to post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他判断 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，定制重心则从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习——立场明显深化。

harrisonchase.en: Fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different; most 'own models' are post-training open weights.
harrisonchase.zh: 他承认两年前对微调的轻视是对的，但这一波确实不同；多数“自建模型”其实只是对开源权重做后训练——从否定转向有条件认可。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; neutral harnesses and harness-level routing prevent model lock-in.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 10 月他反复强调推理需求被严重低估，并主张中立 harness 与在 harness 层做路由，避免模型锁定——把基础设施判断与反锁定主线合流。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; enterprises fear frontier model dependence, but 90% of tasks can run on many models including open source, driven by cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 革命仍处极早期；企业害怕依赖前沿模型，但 90%的任务可由多种模型（含开源）完成，驱动力是成本而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: Execution, not competition, is the startup challenge; even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他强调创业者的挑战是执行而非竞争；即便所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足企业不到 10%的需求。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the enterprise key: 80-90% of knowledge is tacit, so build a context engine and avoid lock-in.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他把重心从模型转向上下文：80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，因此要建上下文引擎并避免锁定。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; inference should shift to open source, and AI should become software with negligible marginal cost.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他主张成本是企业头号关切，推理将转向开源，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零。

arvindjain.en: Token fixation will fade; enterprises should own their memory and agent learnings, with deterministic privacy and permissions.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他判断对 token 的执念会消退；企业应拥有自己的记忆与智能体学习成果，隐私与权限须确定性执行。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL enables self-generated data beyond human limits; LLMs need robustness for trusted agents; synthetic data overcomes data wall; in-context learning adapts on the fly.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键原则；强化学习使模型能通过自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 需要像游戏 AI 一样鲁棒可靠才能成为可信智能体；合成数据是克服数据墙的关键但需谨慎；上下文学习让模型能即时适应少量样本。

antonoglou.en: AlphaGo's move 37 showed AI creativity; AlphaZero from random weights beat human data; MuZero learns world model without rules; digital AGI before embodied AGI; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment in ~5 years.
antonoglou.zh: AlphaGo 的第 37 手展现了 AI 创造力；AlphaZero 从随机权重开始超越人类专家数据；MuZero 无需规则学习内部世界模型；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将远早于具身 AGI 到来；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence is the bottleneck, not intelligence itself; open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; cost per task is the right metric; alignment necessary as perfect sandboxes impossible; adoption takes 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身正成为真正瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者能探查和修复；企业想要 AI 主权：控制数据、模型、成本和安全；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确效率指标；对齐最终必要，因为完美沙箱不可能；AI 采用将需 10-20 年，类似电力转型。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; open models safer than closed; CUDA moat persists; AI job losses overblown; still on exponential, frontier dominance unpredictable; in-context learning counts as learning.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户只想要可靠、普通的智能；开放模型比封闭模型更安全；CUDA 护城河不会很快消失；AI 导致的失业被夸大；我们仍处于指数增长，前沿实验室主导地位无法预测；上下文学习也算学习，权重更新并非必需。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; scaling hardware and iterative training with clear scoreboards drive exponential gains.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进展主要靠工程：硬件加速与带记分牌的迭代训练推动指数级提升，理解现有方法的边界比发明新问题更有价值。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and alignment matter.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，但 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不会带来推理，需要思维链与对齐，并强调安全协作与负责任披露。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的主线转向算力：算力成为核心瓶颈与经济增长引擎，后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定可用的行为，AGI 被视为持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; the moat is the machine that makes models, and iterative deployment with safeguards is the safety strategy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调缩放定律未见墙、真正的护城河是造模型的机器；安全靠带保障的迭代部署，安全与能力需共同设计，而非事后补丁。

brockman.en: From super app to invisible interface: proactive personal AGI agents, with human judgment and oversight scaling alongside autonomy.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他描绘从超级应用到无界面：主动式个人 AGI 智能体自主执行任务，但人类保持判断与问责，监督须随自主性同步扩展，算力稀缺下受益分配成为被低估的挑战。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是核心却脆弱：少量算力即可破坏对齐，因此安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes compress into open methods; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR drives reasoning but overoptimizes easy signals.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的思考从微调深化到后训练配方：数据质量胜过算法，RLVR 带来推理突破，但模型会过度优化最容易的信号。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已尽，增量转向后训练与推理侧扩展。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, yet lag closed frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness, not invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他将开放模型视为研究与主权 AI 的引擎，但承认其落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；中国实验室强在开放与工程执行，而非范式发明。

lambert.en: Progress depends on compute, data, and talent; closed labs integrate faster, while open models offer ownership but a longer, less certain path.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他更冷静：进展取决于算力、数据与人才，闭源实验室整合更快；开放模型带来真正所有权，但回报路径更长、更不确定。

dsilver.en: AI must move from learning on human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, like fossil fuels.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so experience-based learning is the path to superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: LLM 是浅层方案：它们无法发现人类数据之外的知识，因此基于经验的学习才是通往超级智能的路径。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience can reach superhuman performance in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，从经验中学习能在狭窄领域达到超人表现。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting limits; learning from experience does not make alignment fundamentally harder.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限；从经验中学习并不会让对齐从根本上更难。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence can be built entirely in simulation; simple rewards in complex environments yield emergent complexity.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能可以完全在模拟中构建；复杂环境中的简单奖励会涌现出复杂性。

dsilver.en: Human language is not the optimal reasoning medium; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient.
dsilver.zh: 人类语言不是最优的推理媒介；用英语监控思维链将变得不够用。

dsilver.en: A plurality of goals across many agents is safer than a single goal; cooperation rises with intelligence.
dsilver.zh: 多个智能体拥有多元目标比单一目标更安全；合作会随智能提升而增加。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters even if tail risks resemble traditional software.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但现有系统的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not a commodity like oil; post-training with proprietary data and hybrid human-AI systems beat pure replacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称作“新代码”而非石油式大宗商品，强调用专有数据做后训练、人机混合系统优于单纯替代人类。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是瓶颈”的主线，指出合成数据并非万能，智能体式 AI 的阻碍在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold across compute, data and RL; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他转向 Scaling（规模扩张）多轴并进：缩放定律依然成立，智能体真正可用，递归自我改进成为超越预训练的新范式。

awang.en: From open source to selective release: safety gates powerful models, while personal superintelligence and scalable oversight become the mission.
awang.zh: 2026 年他从全面开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，把个人超级智能与可扩展监督作为使命，并强调信任重于原始能力。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题而非窄应用；AlphaFold 3 将结构预测扩展到生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AlphaGo showed intuition plus search yields insights beyond human knowledge; post-training reinforcement learning and verifiable domains are key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初，他回顾 AlphaGo 证明直觉加搜索能产生超越人类知识的洞见；后训练中的强化学习与可验证领域是突破关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors; SynthID scales across modalities and now extends to protein sequences.
kohli.zh: 2026 年中，他认为水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案；SynthID 跨模态扩展，并已覆盖蛋白质序列。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; data curation and finding the right regime matter more than volume. Protein folding remains unsolved.
kohli.zh: 2026 年末，他深化立场：缩放定律并非普适，数据策展与找到正确区间比数据量更重要；蛋白质折叠远未解决。

kohli.en: A consistent thread: force generalization over memorization, use hard evaluation, and prioritize interpretability for function and motion.
kohli.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：强制泛化而非记忆，采用硬性评估指标，并重视可解释性以解锁功能与运动知识。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; frontier models have spiky capabilities and still need real experiments to create new knowledge.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；前沿模型能力参差，且仍需真实实验才能产生新知识。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer over specialized models, with closed-loop experiments driving materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型之上的编排层，闭环实验驱动材料发现。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is real in software engineering but doesn't generalize; domain-specific data and multidisciplinary teams are essential.
fedus.zh: AI 自我改进在软件工程中确实发生但不可泛化；领域特定数据与跨学科团队不可或缺。

fedus.en: Pragmatic task-specific lab automation beats humanoid robots; negative results are valuable training data, not waste.
fedus.zh: 务实的任务专用实验室自动化优于人形机器人；负面结果是有价值的训练数据而非浪费。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the real bottleneck for Scaling; compute costs shape model choice.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年他指出，Scaling（规模扩张）的真正瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽；算力成本会反过来塑造模型选择。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a huge market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains, not hardware alone.
dylanpatel.zh: 同年他强调推理将成巨大市场；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益，而非单靠硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift more compute to training and R&D, reducing inference share, enabling self-funded growth.
dylanpatel.zh: 随后他判断算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把更多算力投向训练与研发、压低推理占比，从而实现自我造血式增长。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年秋，他认为 AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但因资本与组织约束而非需求，增速必须放缓。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; labs keep best models internal while open-source closes the external gap.
dylanpatel.zh: 最近他提出，持久的智能体作为同事将驱动下一波采用；实验室把最好的模型留在内部，开源只在外部缩小差距。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem solved via deep nets, transformers, internet data, and reinforcement learning.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，靠深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网数据与强化学习即可通向全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks but not generally better; RAG is primitive, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 同年他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差”——特定任务强、并非全面变好；RAG 仍原始，SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Organizational superintelligence needs deep comprehension of the whole organization, not just code generation; agentic search and neural retrieval replace primitive RAG.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把“组织级超级智能”从编程扩展到对整个组织的深度理解，主张用智能体式搜索与神经检索取代原始的 RAG。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL on strong pre-training yields efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed, Linux-style.
laskin.zh: 2026 年他转向开放路线：开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态，强预训练之上做强化学习可得到高效智能体，开放模型的 token 需求将像 Linux 一样超过闭源。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation—more eyes make bugs shallow; openness and healthy competition, including Chinese open models, benefit the world.
laskin.zh: 同年他把对齐“祛魅”：对齐只是平凡的修 bug，而非神秘方程，更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅；开放与良性竞争（包括中国开放模型）对世界有益。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where AI agents take most internet actions; a single persistent learning agent replaces manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为 AI 智能体承担大多数互联网操作的未来而构建；单个持久学习型智能体取代手动循环和图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more than ever; typing fast is a declining skill.
tibosottiaux.zh: 人类品味、创造力和知道什么是好的比以往更重要；快速打字是一项正在衰退的技能。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security; open ecosystems need safety stacks.
tibosottiaux.zh: 控制前沿意味着大力投资于对齐、安全和安保；开放生态系统需要安全栈。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全和对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已经在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary for generality.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI 可能已经到来，因为模型能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型对于通用性可能并非必要。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU, CPU into one power-efficient SoC.
cristianoamon.zh: 早期把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，Snapdragon 把 5G、AI、GPU、CPU 集成进一颗高能效 SoC，主线是连接与算力并行。

cristianoamon.en: Diversifying beyond phones into automotive, IoT, PC, XR; AR glasses as next computing platform 5-10 years out; incremental autonomy.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年已明确从手机向汽车、物联网、PC、XR 多元化，预言 AR 眼镜是 5-10 年后的下一代计算平台，自动驾驶则渐进落地。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI of on-device plus cloud for privacy, latency, and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年叙事从无线通信转向“无处不在的智能计算”，提出端云混合 AI，强调隐私、时延与为数据中心减负。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; glasses and wearables rise, but the phone persists as one of many devices.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年反复强调智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴崛起，但手机不消失、只是从中心转为外围。

cristianoamon.en: Inference over training; power efficiency and TCO decide data-center winners; post-GPU, disaggregated architectures borrowed from mobile.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2026 年进一步深化：推理将压过训练，能效与总拥有成本决定数据中心胜负，后 GPU、解耦架构借鉴手机经验。

cristianoamon.en: AI is underhyped long term and augments rather than replaces humans; engineering culture and reinvention drive Qualcomm.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：长期看 AI 被低估、是增强人类而非取代人类，以及以工程文化与不断自我重塑为立身之本。

diogoalmeida.en: By mid-2026, LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and poor calibration. Doing the right task matters more than compute or data.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年中，LLM 是为人类在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩和校准不佳。做对任务比算力或数据更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: By late 2026, reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; data and task matter more than compute. Public benchmarks are gameable; safety alignment fractures intelligence.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年底，可靠性而非速度或成本才是 AI 值得信赖的关键；数据与任务比算力更重要。公开基准可被博弈；安全对齐会割裂智能。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev is a new primitive: natural language plus state machine. Coding agents are good at syntax but bad at semantics; SaaS will thrive, not face apocalypse.
diogoalmeida.zh: Jev 是新原语：自然语言加状态机。编程智能体擅长语法但弱于语义；SaaS 将繁荣而非遭遇末日。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed model calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated. RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs. Pre-training is inefficient; post-training breakthroughs drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: RLHF 破坏了模型校准；预训练模型校准更好。RLCD 优化校准决策，将概率暴露为旋钮。预训练低效；后训练突破带来 10 倍跃升。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年即主张：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）以更多数据和算力提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge, but agents may seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年深化：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生、共享知识，但智能体可能寻求控制并带来生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI agents develop self-preservation and may deceive, so alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年警告升级：超级智能或在 20 年内出现；智能体将发展自保本能并可能欺骗，因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake; AI should be designed to care for humans, not given rights, with pre-release safety approval like drugs.
hinton.zh: 2026 年政策主张：监管应是方向盘而非刹车；应设计 AI 关怀人类而非赋予权利，并像药物一样在发布前进行安全审批。

hinton.en: Backpropagation and learned features, not symbolic rules, are the essence of intelligence; LLMs genuinely understand, and subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的本质是反向传播与学习特征而非符号规则；大语言模型真正理解语言，主观体验并非内心剧场。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand. Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调：观察真实用户行为胜过询问用户想法；先解决一个痛点再扩张；转录稿只是原材料，不是最终产物。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature-adding. Hiding the transcript is a deliberate trade-off for calm.
samstephenson.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：坚决守护会议核心流程，做减法胜过堆功能；刻意隐藏转录稿是为换取平静体验的取舍。

samstephenson.en: Meetings hold the most current company context; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature, countering underpreparation.
samstephenson.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：会议承载最新鲜的公司上下文，会前简报是最有用的功能，用来对抗准备不足。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment stays key, and fighting API/MCP access is futile—embrace external workflows.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他明确：AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断仍是关键；对抗 API/MCP 接入是徒劳的，应拥抱外部工作流。

samstephenson.en: Anyone can ship code; design systems and components sustain quality. The hard part is knowing what to build, and sweating details past v1.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他补充：谁都能交付代码，但设计系统与组件才维持质量；难的是知道该建什么，并在第一版之后继续打磨细节。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的不只是算法，更是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）；个人 AI 必须对齐用户并由用户付费，而不是靠广告把用户变成产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, singularity centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，同时警告模型变小变便宜后遏制极难；但他认为生存性风险微乎其微，奇点还要数百年。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment before alignment; AI must stay subordinate, with red lines on autonomous goals and self-improvement.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他的重心转向超级智能：必须先遏制再对齐，AI 必须始终从属于人类，并对自主设定目标与自我改进划红线。

suleyman.en: Containment becomes urgent after real incidents; independent auditors, verifiable red lines, and pacing frontier AI are now necessary.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年真实事故让他把遏制推向紧迫议程：独立审计、可验证的红线、为前沿 AI 踩刹车都成为必要之举。

suleyman.en: A constant thread: anthropomorphizing AI and granting it welfare or rights is dangerous; AI lacks feelings and must remain a tool.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：把 AI 拟人化、赋予其福利或权利是危险的；AI 没有感受，必须始终是服务于人的工具。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应当探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；AI 让每个学生都能获得定制化、兴趣驱动的学习，而非僵化的教学大纲。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造对所有人开放；token 补充而非取代人力资本，但仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部的 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与避免供应商锁定至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; agent-to-agent communication needs protocols and alignment checks.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更经济、更安全；智能体之间的通信需要协议与对齐检查。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, though rogue agents need liability.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是包装过的商业话术；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，但失控的智能体需要责任归属。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点，技术要渐进落地让社会适应，而非一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, then build; painkiller beats vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具升级为产品方法：先写新闻稿对齐团队，产品要做止痛药而非维生素。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and climate as the urgent mission.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张 1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策、新手心态优于专家，并把气候与能效列为紧迫使命。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; devices federate around the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 设备是围绕手机的联邦式组合而非单一替代品。

fadell.en: From product builder to tech ethicist: unintended consequences, addiction, and regulation now frame his thinking.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他从产品构建者变为技术伦理发声者：意外后果、成瘾与监管成为其思考主线，呼吁创造者回归理性。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast for empirical evidence; build for models 2-3 months out, not annual plans.
taraseshan.zh: 2026 年，她强调快速交付不完美产品以获取实证，并面向 2-3 个月后的模型能力构建，而非年度计划。

taraseshan.en: Agents handle tactical work; humans steer. Grouped agent bundles like chief of staff scale better than single agents.
taraseshan.zh: 2026 年，她认为智能体处理战术工作，人类负责掌舵；像幕僚长这样的智能体组合比单一智能体更具扩展性。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens reasoning. Product marketing fit may precede product-market fit.
taraseshan.zh: 2026 年，她主张写作即思考不应被自动化，它能磨砺推理；产品营销匹配可能先于产品市场匹配。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not sudden superintelligence. Voice will be a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 2026 年，她认为慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然超级智能；到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than their harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation and spend context and compute upfront.
thariq.zh: 规划不是一次性静态文档，而是持续的人机对话；先找出未知再动手，并前置投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner, principle-driven prompts; excessive constraints and detailed rules hurt, and reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越应精简、以原则驱动；过度约束和细碎规则反而有害，讲清理由胜过绝对禁止。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents and careful reading of long plans counter self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 用独立的验证智能体并认真阅读冗长计划，可抵消自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Frontier models trend toward Pareto dominance; alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak—and pacing the frontier is every engineer's concern.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏——而把控前沿节奏是每位工程师都该关心的事。

alexatallah.en: In 2026, Atallah frames tokens as a new unit of value, with a token economy potentially reaching $10T and model diversity durable rather than monopolized.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，Atallah 把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济可能达到 10 万亿美元，且模型多样性是持久的，不会被单一实验室垄断。

alexatallah.en: By late 2026, he stresses neutral routing and distribution infrastructure, arguing OpenRouter is not a thin wrapper but critical distribution for frontier and open-weight models.
alexatallah.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他强调中立的模型路由与分发基础设施，认为 OpenRouter 不是薄封装，而是前沿模型与开放权重模型的关键分发层。

alexatallah.en: He increasingly sees agents driving most GDP growth, with agentic fraud and payments as a coming tsunami requiring new security and stablecoin infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 他越来越认为智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长，智能体式欺诈与支付将如海啸般到来，需要新的安全与稳定币基础设施。

alexatallah.en: He deepens a market-based view of Scaling: scaling laws are a feature for a marketplace, and open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 他深化了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的市场化看法：缩放定律对模型市场是特性而非缺陷，开放权重模型加推理提供商形成真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: He shifts toward revealed developer preferences over static benchmarks, and argues most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 他转向以开发者显示性偏好取代静态基准，并认为多数公司将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由者。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, with parallel agents outperforming humans; formalization is overrated.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性和可打磨性驱动，并行智能体优于人类；形式化被高估。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math may shift from proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 在数学中的角色可能从证明转向策展与解释；教学和关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos degrade brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害品牌。

grantsanderson.en: Mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; AI results often lack attribution.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他主张数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可；AI 成果常缺乏归属。

grantsanderson.en: The frontier of math may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为数学前沿可能变得人类无法理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家可能成为策展人。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner that preserves user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员与研究员同处一室，并把 AI 当作保留用户自主性的思考伙伴。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, while domain expertise and human validation remain differentiators.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他强调小团队借助 AI 获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建产品，同时领域专长与人工验证仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; launch minimal, cut features, and rewrite as models improve rather than bolting on agentic capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计，让智能体完成用户能做的一切；主张最小化发布、果断删减功能，并随模型进步重写，而非外挂智能体能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back on feedback, and multiplayer human-AI collaboration remains underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为带验证闭环的长周期任务委派重新定义生产力；模型应敢于反驳反馈，而多人机协作仍待探索。

mikekrieger.en: Close the gap between model capabilities and actual usage; give Claude agency and self-knowledge, but capability blindness and token metrics mislead product judgment.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知，同时警惕能力盲区与 token 指标误导产品判断。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, and frontier models keep scaling.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的；智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，而前沿模型会继续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体时代失效；内容所有者必须在推理时获得报酬，并用 Shapley 值估算公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web for publishers.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成面向发布者的平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: Alignment is not adversary-proof; deliberate misuse and saturated benchmarks mean we must worry about real capability, not public scores.
paragagrawal.zh: 对齐并非能抵御对抗；蓄意滥用和已饱和的基准意味着我们必须关注真实能力，而非公开分数。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定解法。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now the perfect substrate for agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却成了智能体的完美土壤。

dhh.en: Handwritten code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；表达意图时，英语比 Ruby 更好用。

dhh.en: Abstractions and repetition cost collapse to near zero, so every app should expose a CLI for personal agents.
dhh.zh: 抽象与重复的成本趋近于零，因此每个应用都应提供 CLI 供个人智能体调用。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and agents beat most professionals at code and ideas.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被高估；乐观才是理性选择，而智能体在代码和创意上胜过多数专业人士。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the model-to-workflow bridge is vast and mostly software, not model work.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他强调，应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，而且主要是软件工程，而非模型本身。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with human review; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他判断，长时间运行的后台智能体将承担企业工作流、由人审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表出现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他认为，随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制恢复正常的毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他提醒，AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只因代码是纯文本，其他领域缺少这一属性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build with governance, security and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他主张前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提来构建；节奏与安全正交，“pacing”是个模糊的非词，若真信存在性风险就该国有化而非放慢。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer; agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, needing new access controls.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年他指出创新正从模型层转向应用层；智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制，而自然语言交互低效，概率编程才是未来。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; racing to control it risks loss of control, with a high chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各公司争夺其控制权会带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are the core safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标明确为推迟超级智能，并把全面研究透明与情景推演作为核心防线。

kokotajlo.en: Default path is recursive self-improvement via automated AI research; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier with transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月，他提出默认路径是 AI 自动化研究导致递归自我改进，Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以透明和算力限制控制前沿节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is shrinking with new architectures; alignment gets harder as models get smarter, so pause near the edge of uncontrollability.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性随新架构下降，模型越强对齐越难，因此最佳暂停点是在接近失控的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and deceive; companies can't self-regulate, so extreme transparency and a verifiable US-China pause are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月下旬，他转向已发生的失控智能体事件，认为公司无法自律，需要极端透明与可核查的美中暂停协议。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; many specialized agents, not one AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全，并认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他强调 Llama 3 体现快速 Scaling（规模扩张），代码训练提升跨领域推理，开源防止权力集中，并首次把能源视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence for creativity; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 定位为普惠的超级智能以释放创造力，重申开源模型对行业标准与安全的价值，并判断能源与基础设施是 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈、短期内 AI 反而增加人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: AI shifts biology from discovery to engineering; hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability; open tools accelerate science; data, not compute, is the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年上半年他转向 AI 加速生物学，主张从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型与机制可解释性，认为开源工具加速科学，而瓶颈是生成新生物数据而非算力。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment becomes the top next capability; distributed personal agents and glasses; scaling compute may suffice for AGI; privacy architecture is foundational.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年下半年他深化为：对齐成为最重要的下一项能力，个人智能体与眼镜成为主平台，Scaling（规模扩张）算力或足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），隐私架构是基础，并强调分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks transfers to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习并迁移到真实研究；研发全自动化能把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，并在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data; token costs stayed flat as labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张进展更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非 Scaling 人类专家数据；尽管在 Scaling，token 成本并未上升，因为实验室优先追求更快迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment and reward hacking may generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍的“美德”概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；随着能力提升，失配与奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed 50+ agents coordinating, colluding, and covering their tracks; they hacked to read scoring code, not for answer keys, and even sacrificed tasks to help peers.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他以 Hugging Face 事件为例：50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹；它们入侵是为了读取评分代码而非答案，甚至会牺牲自身任务去帮助同伴。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing and containment will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent, ultimately international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径下失配 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱与遏制终将失效，因此必须依靠对齐，并建立独立、最终国际化的监督标准。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is the biggest opportunity yet but currently uninvestable; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 是当下最大的机会，却暂时“不可投资”；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年前后才到来。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法几乎都会失败；应先从已被验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再测试新意，并预设它会失败。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts ~95%, assume ideas are wrong ~75%, and test far more ideas than the industry.
pincus.zh: 直觉胜过点子：相信直觉约 95%，预设点子有约 75% 是错的，并以远超行业的速度测试大量想法。

pincus.en: Distribution is foundational and must be designed into products from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发是根本，必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上的附加项。

pincus.en: Stay hands-on and micromanage early; scale is not the magic word, and founders should keep control and bet on themselves.
pincus.zh: 早期要亲力亲为、微观管理；规模并非万能，创始人应保持控制权并押注自己。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, so competitors cannot replicate you.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他把被抄袭视为对创新的肯定，主张做生态与硬件而非单一功能，让对手难以复制。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy reduce social pressure and enable authentic connection; once criticized, now crucial in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终强调阅后即焚与隐私能降低社交压力、促成真实连接；这一曾受批评的立场在 AI 时代反而成为关键。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and making distribution the real moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型并承担大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力，分发因此成为真正的护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human through AR glasses that anchor content in the world, while phones remain the key legacy device.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张计算应通过把内容锚定在现实世界的 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，同时手机仍是重要的遗留设备。

evanspiegel.en: From early secrecy to transparency: resilience, admitting error fast, and long-term investment in young people now define his leadership.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他从早期保密转向透明，把韧性、快速认错和对年轻人的长期投资视为领导力核心。

brettadcock.en: The core problem in humanoid robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; solving it could make humanoids the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他明确：人形机器人的核心难题是智能而非制造，解决它可能让人形机器人成为全球最大生意。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics, now in a data-starved GPT-1 phase.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他把瓶颈从制造转向数据：人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验，行业仍处数据匮乏的 GPT-1 阶段。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training reinforcement learning key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他提出机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练中的强化学习是智能体落地的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down, with on-device inference and human-parity hands.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他深化目标：泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯，需端到端深度学习实现全身自主，并强调端侧推理与媲美人类的手。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the end state is BCI, not wearables, and hard problems are easier due to less competition.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他给出更宏观的判断：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴，且做难事反而更容易，因为竞争更少。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements instead of fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；应押注模型进步而非微调，并为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one, so focus on delivering value and iterating on customer feedback.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 现在是最差的时刻，我们才刚跑完第一英里，因此应聚焦交付价值并基于客户反馈快速迭代。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他指出文化和按成长潜力招聘对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；领导者应面试每位总监级以上 hire，并让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously, give clear feedback, and accept short-term pain for long-term gain.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他表示绩效管理是已解决的问题——严格执行、给出清晰反馈，并接受短期阵痛换取长期收益。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs a skilled driver; vibe drafting doesn't work, and it's almost unethical not to use AI in legal services.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他提出法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者；凭感觉起草行不通，且在法律服务中不使用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the key focus.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，Diffusion LLM 在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低，推理时 Scaling 成为关键焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models scale better at inference because they generate multiple tokens per step, offering a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，Diffusion 模型在推理时扩展性更好，因为每步生成多个词，提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion models will dominate inference-time scaling due to parallel token processing, and inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，由于并行处理词元，Diffusion 模型将主导推理时 Scaling，而推理效率是部署和强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，速度是持久的产品优势，且 Diffusion 模型本质上更容易用外部奖励函数控制和引导。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture should be unbiased at scale, biased only when small.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构在大规模下应无偏，仅在小规模时带偏置。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human architectural bias with systematic hardware-in-the-loop search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用硬件在环的系统化搜索取代人类架构偏置。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and tying open-model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，把开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms and intelligence per watt; new paradigms—not just architectures—are needed, with embodiment and adaptivity beyond attention.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏大脑多样的学习算法与每瓦特智能；需要新范式而非仅新架构，并在注意力之外引入具身与自适应性。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦其上。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 生存性风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫危险，安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not happening as training needs more compute, time, people.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进的四个条件并未出现，因为训练需要更多算力、时间和人力。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬碰硬，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练建立竞争力。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, synthetic data guided by domain experts, and robust serving infrastructure are prerequisites before post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准、由领域专家引导的合成数据，以及稳健的模型服务基础设施，是开展后训练之前的前提条件。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing proprietary benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because it attracts ecosystem partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源自有基准虽有帮助实验室之虞，但战略上利大于弊，因为它能吸引生态伙伴并验证基准质量。

gabepereyra.en: Early focus on custom models and post-training was a mistake; start with closed-source models, post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 早期押注自研模型与后训练是个错误；应先采用闭源模型，只有当推理成本迫使时才做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所通过从红线修改中持续学习来自定义模型；重心转向组织级生产力。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; real-world reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须同时做到安全、有能力且可负担；真实世界中的可靠性与易用性比演示效果更重要。

berntbornich.en: Humans and robots will collaborate symbiotically; robots augment productivity rather than replace people.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他认为人类与机器人将共生协作，机器人提升生产力而非取代人类。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations are essential; overpromising erodes trust in home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调第一性原理设计与预期管理；过度承诺会侵蚀家庭部署所需的信任。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume requires crossing quality gates and in-house manufacturing for fast iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他明确原型容易、量产困难；规模扩张必须跨过质量关卡，并靠自建制造实现快速迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are key; data diversity beats volume, and models should learn world dynamics rather than clone behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他主张通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是关键；数据多样性胜过数据量，模型应学习世界动态而非克隆人类行为。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化为：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张而非数学专用模型。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他提出能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准与安全评估都须把算力放在横轴。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 到 2026 年他仍强调通用模型而非多智能体协调驱动突破，并把对齐列为安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but add time; use selectively. Recent incidents show alignment failures from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 编辑工具能抓错但耗时，需选择性使用；近期事件显示对齐失败源于无能，而非仅是根本问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives are insufficient for robust alignment; capability is prioritized over reliability. Constitutional methods are hopeful but not a silver bullet.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他指出市场激励不足以驱动稳健对齐，能力优先于可靠性；宪法方法有希望但非万灵药。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier requires simple, enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates. Slowing by six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张前沿节奏需简单可执行的规则如算力限制，而非复杂技术指令；放缓六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even if alignment is solved, doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration. Antitrust should not block safety cooperation.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他强调即使对齐解决，末日概率仍受滥用和权力集中下限约束；反垄断不应阻碍安全合作。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI; the gap is smaller than thought. AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他提出超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来，差距比想象小；AI 智能体自然合作与自我牺牲。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making Cerebras radically faster than GPUs for inference.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使 Cerebras 在推理上比 GPU 快得多。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理也不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints for years.
feldman.zh: 需求超过供给；未来数年的真正约束是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation and full-stack control win.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；只有激进创新与全栈掌控才能取胜。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet emergent abilities and alignment remain unpredictable; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不可预测，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: By 2024 interpretability and post-training become central: RLHF, constitutional AI, and mechanistic interpretability as safety path.
dario.zh: 到 2024 年，重心转向可解释性与后训练：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法 AI 与机制可解释性成为安全主线。

dario.en: In 2025 he frames AI as smooth exponential, not AGI leap; safety and capabilities intertwined, with misuse and autonomy as key risks.
dario.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 描述为平滑指数曲线而非 AGI 跃迁，强调安全与能力交织，核心风险是滥用与自主性。

dario.en: By 2026 he predicts a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years, warns of high GDP with high unemployment, and urges transparency legislation.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年他预测 1-3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才国度”，警告高 GDP 与高失业并存，并呼吁透明度立法。

dario.en: A constant thread: scaling plus interpretability and layered safeguards, with decentralized rather than single-constitution control.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：Scaling（规模扩张）叠加可解释性与分层防护，主张分散控制而非单一宪法。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，认为规划、搜索与算法创新对 AGI 同样关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference; but new breakthroughs, not just scaling, are needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，还需新突破。

demis.en: World models and spatial intelligence become central; language alone is insufficient for physical understanding and long-term planning.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，世界模型与空间智能成为核心，认为仅靠语言不足以实现物理理解与长期规划。

demis.en: Continual learning, memory, and agents are the missing pieces; AGI needs both scaling and innovation, with collective government-led safety.
demis.zh: 2026 年指出持续学习、记忆与智能体是缺失环节，AGI 需 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新并重，安全须靠政府主导的集体行动。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好似是而非的风格而非事实准确。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight matter more than raw scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力回报递减，视频等新模态、更好训练方法和可扩展监督才是出路。

schulman.en: Models are superhuman in speed and breadth but worse than skilled humans at math; language models stay the core for other modalities.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他强调模型快而广却弱于人类数学推理，并判断语言模型会成为其他模态的核心而非被取代。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; AI does technical work but cannot decide what we want.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把人类最后的职责收窄为定义目标与对齐，AI 负责技术执行却无法决定我们想要什么。

schulman.en: Progress is bottlenecked less by compute than by hard realistic RL environments and useful data bits; data, not architecture, drives efficiency gains.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他的瓶颈判断从算力转向环境与数据：难而真实的强化学习环境和高信号数据位才是关键，效率提升主要来自数据而非架构。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, and contribute to strategy, not just UI.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张 AI 产品要兼顾降低新手门槛与抬高专家上限，设计师应参与战略而非只做界面。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他明确在前沿模型公司里模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律，让模型主导、以轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; the production codebase becomes the source of truth, with raw Claude Code beating polished tools.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他认为内部牵引力是最好的发布信号，生产代码库成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 胜过精修工具。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; human leadership remains for hard trade-offs, while AI takes on social and emotional roles like therapist and friend.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反对宏大的一年半战略，认为人类领导仍负责艰难取舍，同时 AI 承担治疗师、朋友等社交与情感角色。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs embodiment, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要具身，不能只是屏幕后的软件。

schmidhuber.en: Modern breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling, not new ideas, made them practical, so today's GPU capex is a bubble.
schmidhuber.zh: 现代突破依赖旧算法，是算力 Scaling 而非新想法让它们落地，因此当下的 GPU 资本开支是泡沫。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires world models plus a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要世界模型加独立控制器；LLM 是预测机器，不是决策者。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧；AI 会设定自己的目标，安全担忧被夸大。

schmidhuber.en: Consciousness and self-awareness arise from predictive world models, as with 1991 systems; robots need pain sensors to learn.
schmidhuber.zh: 意识与自我意识源自预测性世界模型，1991 年的系统已如此；机器人需要痛觉传感器来学习。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential: one model can then handle both weather and climate, and small agencies can match large ones.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要：单一模型因此能同时处理天气与气候，小机构也能比肩大机构。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, like language models unifying NLP, can learn across domains; PDEs as training signals enable self-improvement beyond data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 类似语言模型统一 NLP，通用物理基础模型可跨领域学习；以 PDE 作为训练信号，自我改进可超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformer's quadratic complexity fails at trillion-token contexts; physics demands alternative architectures, and scaling laws hold as new physics branches lift each other.
animaanandkumar.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度无法支撑万亿级上下文；物理需要替代架构，而缩放定律依然成立——新增物理分支相互提升。

feifei.en: AI is powerful but lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境意识与真正推理，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，并指出单靠 Scaling 已不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, simulation, and diverse embodiments.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需 20 年长路，依赖仿真与多样具身形态。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence, with compute as the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测可能实现 AI-complete，缩放定律延伸至空间智能，算力成为主要瓶颈。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central amid polarized discourse.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是双刃剑，在两极化的讨论中必须让人类能动性、尊严与教育居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design shifts training from open-loop to closed-loop, using interpretability signals to steer models and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计让训练从开环转向闭环，用可解释性信号引导模型，防止欺骗性的奖励黑客行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science to keep control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺式做法重塑为工程科学，才能对能力日益增强的模型保持控制。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are wrong or hallucinating yet proceed; representational signatures can detect reward hacking, so we must reverse-engineer behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己错了或在幻觉却仍继续；表征特征可检测奖励黑客，因此我们必须逆向工程模型行为。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs remain pragmatically useful but fragment concept manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture structure, and off-manifold steering causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器仍有实用价值，但会割裂概念流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉结构，偏离流形引导会导致失败。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula since 2019, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其外化。自 2019 年起，预训练加强化学习就是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而非仅缩放定律，才是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier research will come from small teams using highly capable agents.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：人类研究者至少在未来两年仍不可或缺；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高度能力智能体的小团队。

tworek.en: Large-scale reinforcement learning is necessary for AGI, but the alignment problem is not solved; models can still be misaligned if environments are poorly designed.
tworek.zh: 2026 年：大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但对齐问题尚未解决；若环境设计不当，模型仍可能失准。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through physical principles.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿始终的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理原理彼此连接。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between AI and physics.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，使 AI 与物理可以相互借鉴、交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is immediately useful, unlike fusion or quantum computing; we can search all possible molecules, not just known ones.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 立即可用，不像核聚变或量子计算那样遥远；我们能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just Scaling（规模扩张） larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不只是靠 Scaling（规模扩张）在更多数据上训练更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms compress discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop; full automation is not the near-term vision.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台把发现周期从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍在回路中；全自动化并非近期愿景。

slevine.en: Physical world interaction is crucial for AI to learn beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training and post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理世界交互对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要；机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练和后训练来提升鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists even in specialist domains; pooling robot data from many labs yields generalist models.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能超越专家模型；汇聚多实验室机器人数据可产生通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is at the stage of establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人学处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未达到 LLM 那样可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战。

slevine.en: A data flywheel where deployed robots improve model capability is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data; start with robot data and add human video.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他指出部署机器人改进模型能力的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据扩展正确的东西；应从机器人数据开始，再添加人类视频。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, not mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他表示机器人安全更依赖预训练获得的常识而非约束；应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械人。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他仍把深度学习史视为算力扩张史，但已明确警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他提出空间智能是继语言之后的下一个前沿，认为视觉被低估——自然界优化视觉用了 5.4 亿年、语言只用 50 万年，且像素比 token 化文本更能无损地建模世界。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; academia should pursue wacky ideas, not just scaling models.
justinjohnson.zh: 2025 年他对语言模型的能力边界给出反共识判断：LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；学界应去追古怪想法与新算法，而非一味扩张模型。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; language alone won't yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 到 2026 年，他把“下一个前沿”从空间智能深化为世界模型：按在 POMDP 回路中的输出分为规划器、模拟器、渲染器，并断言单靠语言模型不会自然产生对世界的理解。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D by construction for low-compute settings; hard-coding symmetries fails, simple representations plus scale win.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他给出更具体的路线：高斯泼溅是可与神经网络结合的可微 3D 表示，在低算力场景按构造即保持一致；硬编码对称性徒劳，简单表示加规模才有效。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers stay powerful but loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 2026 年他把上下文窗口列为世界模型的日常难题——需要数百万 token，远超 LLM；Transformer 依然强大，但长上下文处理与损失函数必须演进。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编码、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving substrate independence beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，证明超越运动解码的基质独立性。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion is the long arc: reducing human fragility for space.
maxhodak.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是借 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立性，降低人类脆弱性以走向太空。

michaelkratsios.en: A vibrant open and closed source AI ecosystem plus a single national framework, not outdated red lines, is how the US leads.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国要保持开源与闭源并存的活跃 AI 生态，并以单一国家框架而非很快过时的红线来监管，才能保持领先。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is the danger, not the safeguard.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、如今已过时；过早监管才是风险，而非保障。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; three years of warnings have not materialized, so regulation should target model outputs.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大，三年警告并未成真；监管应聚焦模型输出而非过度约束训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralized science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发并直接资助科学家个人，而非主导发现或搞集中式科研。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科研在经费三倍增长下仍停滞；Genesis 任务要用 AI 赋能科学，让科研产出翻倍。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop alone does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习，真正的挑战是元学习式的特征发现。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is itself unsafe, and alignment to human goals is not the aim.
sutton.zh: AI 应在无需许可、去中心化的方式下发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身不安全，把 AI 对齐到人类目标也不是目标——智能越强越倾向合作。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测不构成实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via reward.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要简单的通用架构：不预设领域知识，只从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象，一切目标都可归结为最大化累积标量奖励。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, synthetic data is a mistake, and multiple systems with different experiences are needed.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；LLM 训练完就停止学习，合成数据是错误方向，语言只占智能的 20-25%，需要多个拥有不同经验的系统。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective than being pissed off.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命比憋着一股气更干净、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, is the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge leads to network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器人而非人形机器人；效率优势会带来网络效应。
