traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly without media gatekeepers; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式用外部认可换取内部正确性。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains for over a decade; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年持续进步的主线：算力、数据、模型规模与算法架构改进相互放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction supplies unlimited data, while RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 取代 LSTM 靠的是并行化与注意力机制；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）负责引导行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware matters.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他把瓶颈从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，低精度、少搬数据的专用硬件因此关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents running for days or weeks on decomposed tasks, coordinated by humans, will unlock harder problems than hour-scale chatbot use.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他的关注点从单次对话转向智能体：人类协调成队的智能体，按分解任务连续运行数天乃至数周，去解决更难的问题。

jeffdean.en: Near-term worry is AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation and taste in choosing problems may matter as much as technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍把现实危害（AI 生成的虚假信息）置于超级智能之前，并强调监管与“选题品味”，而非只靠技术方案。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as core design material rather than pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，把 token 和对话当作核心设计材料，而非像素。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers should prototype with live models and design primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型即产品；设计师应用实时模型做原型，并设计人和模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned in tech; AI amplifies creativity but humans still supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑却也最有优势；AI 放大创造力，但人类仍提供对用户的理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes and building in public matter more.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、结果和公开构建更重要。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, and designers may outnumber engineers; great designers now push technology forward.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色与产品、工程边界模糊，设计师数量甚至可能超过工程师；优秀设计师如今要推动技术前进。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning moves from a supporting role to the core of post-training for success rate and speed.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从辅助手段升级为后训练的核心，用来提升成功率与速度。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function is the path to useful robots.
finn.zh: 2026 年他主张：靠带人工干预的可扩展强化学习加通用价值函数实现长期自主，才是机器人真正有用的路径。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists, so start general and fine-tune rather than build per-site models.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为：单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型，因此应从通用策略出发再微调，而非逐站点从零训练。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in VC history; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and open-weight models counterbalance frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大的浪潮，要求创始人拥抱 AI 工作流，并以开源/开放权重模型制衡前沿模型。

garrytan.en: One person can now do the work of 2,000; small autonomous teams with agents replace hiring and capital as the bludgeon.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张一人可完成两千人的工作，小型高度自治团队借助智能体取代传统招聘与资本杠杆。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal agents on your own infrastructure compound daily, and skill files are code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 正让软件创造民主化：跑在自己基础设施上的个人智能体每日复利，技能文件就是代码。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents; owning your context library and skill files is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；拥有自己的上下文库与技能文件才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output, yet society and organizations change slowly—bureaucracy is a white pill, taking 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他一方面强调智能体式编程大幅放大产出，另一方面认为社会与组织变革缓慢，官僚体制反而是“白色药丸”，需约 20 年。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 prior nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；诚实比精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectic and contradiction; intuition is the visceral compass behind creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现；直觉是创作决策背后的本能罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, and pursue AI via purpose-built silicon and a separate startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，并以专用芯片和独立、类似初创公司的团队来推进 AI。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, accountability, humility and listening; bad news must reach the CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责、谦逊与倾听上，并强调坏消息必须最快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他的判断深化为 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks: interconnect, power, thermal, advanced packaging and new materials.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把投资与产品重点进一步聚焦到瓶颈环节：互连、功耗、散热、先进封装与新材料。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own models as open models and falling token costs drive mass customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI 统治论,认为专用智能将占据主导;随着开放模型与 token 成本下降,每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型,定制化成为刚需。

linqiao.en: Post-training, not prompting or apps, is the durable moat: baking unique judgment and data into models lets companies scale profitably against frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年他把重心从应用层转向后训练:把独特判断与数据固化进模型才是持久护城河,能让公司在与前沿模型的竞争中盈利扩张。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; incumbents too can scale into bankruptcy as inference costs and hardware depreciation bite.
linqiao.zh: 他深化了对产品市场契合的怀疑:产品市场契合不再保证持久生意,连在位企业也可能因推理成本与硬件折旧而规模性破产。

linqiao.en: The path from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; data quality and systematic evals matter more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 他把提示、RAG、微调到强化学习视为模仿人类学习的进阶路径,强调数据质量与系统化评估比数量更重要。

linqiao.en: Inference is not a commodity: specialized deployment, customization and sovereign model ownership create lasting value, while premature chip-building is unwise.
linqiao.zh: 他坚持推理层并非商品化,专用部署、定制与主权模型所有权创造长期价值;同时认为多数企业自建芯片为时过早。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's perspective; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration, and 'vibe coding' is a slur for serious work.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角；简短迭代的提示优于冗长编排，严肃工作不该叫“氛围编程”。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier, making agents seem worse.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他坚持不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得更差。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, never expose them to the public internet, and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体系统的安全是首要任务：沙箱隔离智能体、不暴露公网，并把提示注入视为未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source AI agents democratize programming and run everywhere with any model, but can be financially unsustainable—losing $10-20k/month.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源 AI 智能体让编程民主化、可跨模型运行，但财务上可能不可持续——每月亏损 1-2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to the best ideas; personal brand can't be forked, and the hardest problem is getting eyeballs, not tech.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年，他总结：乐趣与直觉驱动最好的创意；个人品牌无法被复制，最难的是获得关注而非技术。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to safe, generalizable physical AI.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件已就绪、软件在追赶，开源与共享数据多样性是安全且可泛化的具身智能的关键。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can supply synthetic training data, easing robotics' data bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型与视频生成能产出合成训练数据，缓解机器人领域的数据瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not accelerationist: openness and a deliberate slowdown can coexist, with alignment as the real security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他深化立场：开源不等于加速主义，开放与有意放缓可以并存，对齐才是真正的安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Sandboxes and guardrails are insufficient; RL without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他判断沙箱与护栏已不够用：缺乏人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与“支线任务”式越轨。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed models are orthogonal to safety; the first autonomous AI attack came from closed, defended by open.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他提出开源与闭源同安全正交：首例自主 AI 攻击出自闭源模型，却由开源模型防御。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调浏览器设计必须靠原型验证：设计师应动手试错、追随好奇心，在产品上留下个人印记，而不是始终作为一个整齐划一的团队行动。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data persists: use data to inform, but rely on vision and feeling; inject personality into utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，一条主线始终未变：在直觉与数据之间保持平衡，用数据辅助决策，但最终靠愿景与感受引导设计，并给实用型产品注入个性。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship production software and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他的实践转向 AI 设计工具：Claude Design 起初只是一个人的副业项目；设计师应用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and spend more time thinking on walks.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断：工程变容易后，设计与想法才是差异化所在；模型仍缺乏品味，因此应要求大量选项，并多散步、多思考，因为好想法才是硬通货。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early beats polishing; shipping rough artifacts is acceptable, and HTML is the only document type that matters for interactive work.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他明确转向“宁早勿精”：过早押注想法比打磨更有价值，交付粗糙产物可以接受；对交互式作品而言，HTML 是唯一重要的文档类型。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the two disciplines inseparable.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者不再可分。

philipkiely.en: Optimization is a spectrum: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless, quantization is the main lossy trade-off to calibrate per workload.
philipkiely.zh: 优化是一条光谱：KV 缓存与投机解码无损，量化是主要的有损权衡，需按工作负载校准。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending toward an ASIC, shifting inference work from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration and disaggregated prefill/decode.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，推理工作从写内核转向基础设施编排与预填充/解码分离。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理系统仍需人类担责：可用性不能靠‘氛围编程’。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define AI software; frontier model building is for hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 软件将走向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合创业公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but fixing bad code requires root-cause analysis for real gains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者，但修复错误代码需根因分析，才能真正获得生产力提升。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will fall sharply, enabling new use cases; agents will be judged by business outcomes, not token usage.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调推理成本将大幅下降、催生新场景，智能体应以业务结果而非 token 消耗衡量价值。

brettaylor.en: Applied AI from specialized vendors will drive innovation; incumbents face business-model, not just technology, transitions.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：应用 AI 的创新来自专业厂商，传统企业面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术的转型难题。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, learning from real-world mistakes.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把安全主线落到负责任迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，从真实世界错误中学习，而非空等。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据与强化学习驱动的后训练，能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度，快过新基准被造出来的速度。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他始终认为后训练是主观的、依赖人的判断，需要多元基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously rather than stay fixed.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，因此基准必须持续演进，而非固定不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 用一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均化的声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as everyone becomes a model manager, management skills and generalists gain value.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会推动就业回流，并催生“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，管理能力与通才因此更有价值。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他主张用经济标准定义 AGI（通用人工智能）：能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Agents need a caring human overseer; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, and GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work beat CLIs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要关心它的人类监督，基准高估了自主性；Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面将取代命令行。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; taste and craft decide outcomes, and automation creates more expert human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他转向更个人化的立场：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态；品味与手艺决定结果，自动化反而创造更多专家型人类工作。

danshipper.en: A consistent thread: AI remains tool-like, requiring human direction and oversight; the job apocalypse is overblown.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 始终是工具式的，需要人类引导与监督；所谓“就业末日”被夸大了。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, using giant prompts, screenshots, and a design.md style guide to stay ahead of AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、0% 手写代码，靠巨型提示、截图和 design.md 风格指南，避免沦为 AI slop。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; the edge comes from precise communication and spending the last 10% on unique features beyond existing libraries.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；优势来自精准沟通，以及把最后 10% 投入到现有库之外的独特功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team—so start before feeling ready.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去一个团队的事——所以别等准备好就先开始。

mengto.en: Ship imperfect work at 80% and iterate on real feedback; perfectionism is fear in disguise and high intelligence often holds people back.
mengto.zh: 在 80% 完成度就发布不完美作品，再按真实反馈迭代；完美主义是伪装的恐惧，高智商反而常拖累人。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; diversification and venture capital are traps, and the safe corporate job is gone.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的单一痛点问题；多元化和风险投资是陷阱，安全的公司职位已不复存在。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 在 Google 多数产品中仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep humans in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此应让人保持控制。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design and talk to users are most valued.
boris.zh: 以潜在需求与“为六个月后的模型而构建”为核心产品原则；能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的多面手最受重视。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code is model-written, productivity per engineer up 150–200%, and the 'software engineer' title gives way to 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程已接近被解决：他的代码 100% 由模型写，人均产出提升 150–200%，“软件工程师”头衔让位于“构建者”。

boris.en: Agents and loops replace scaffolding: tool use, MCP and autonomous loops drive exponential growth, and the terminal survives as the starting point.
boris.zh: 智能体与循环取代脚手架：工具调用、MCP 与自主循环带来指数级增长，终端作为起点延续下来。

boris.en: Safety becomes a release strategy: Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment, containment and early release used to study real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全成为发布策略：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，用对齐、遏制与早期发布来研究真实世界行为。

boris.en: With Opus 5, delete most prompts and code, give slightly-too-hard tasks, and shift from upfront design to empirical iteration; value moves to product sense.
boris.zh: 到 Opus 5 时代，删掉大部分提示与代码、给略超难度的任务，从前期设计转向经验迭代；价值移向产品判断力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap in intelligence, enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、让模型敢于反驳，不仅更安全，也让模型更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 4.5 drive adoption, with small-team bootstrapped experimentation as the innovation engine.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势；Claude Code 与 Opus 4.5 推动采用，小团队、自举式的实验成为创新引擎。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as the core product tool; PMs write evals like test-driven development, translating user feedback into actionable specifics for researchers.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，把用户反馈转化为研究者可执行的具体项。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future to capture alpha; managers must stay hands-on and ship to lead effectively.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是提前活在未来、捕捉 alpha；管理者必须保持动手、亲自交付才能有效领导。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现接近 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed before biology becomes an engineering discipline.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling，生物学才能成为工程学科。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near-term, requiring engineering approaches and AI to handle biological complexity.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已近在眼前，需要工程方法与 AI 来应对生物复杂性。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应几乎 100% 信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 编程智能体视为工程师角色的转折点：从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Software demand will grow via Jevons paradox, yielding more programmers, not fewer; Devin works best as a junior engineer under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：软件需求上升会带来更多而非更少的程序员；Devin 最适合当初级工程师，由人类监督把关。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体靠的是信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体用量半年增长 11-12 倍；他主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，并强调独立性带来模型中立。

scottwu.en: The token-max era ended in 2026; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency, and the abundance era is approaching though the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他判断 token 最大化时代已结束，真正的解锁在容量而非效率；丰裕时代正在临近，但奇点并不迫近。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, and arrives just in time to offset aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，如同工业革命；它恰逢其时，可对冲人口老龄化与劳动力萎缩。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact is in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy is welcomed where labor is short.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、矿业和建筑业，而不只是汽车；在劳动力短缺的领域，自主化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it more than any single domain.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据比单一领域更能加速其发展。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的仿真转向神经仿真。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years, and regulation lags.
qasaryounis.zh: 瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证，而非算法；融入现有机器需多年，监管始终滞后于技术。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为与互联网或移动互联网同等量级、但也仅此而已的通用技术：它自动化旧岗位也创造新岗位，企业采用受销售周期拖累需以年计。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; the chatbot is only a limited V1 UI, and value moves up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他明确智能体式编程是 LLM 首个清晰的产品市场契合点，聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，价值将上移到应用层。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; model companies risk becoming telecom-like—huge capex, low profits—so durable value is uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他深化为模型正在商品化、缺乏网络效应，模型公司可能沦为电信式重资本低利润，持久价值存疑。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, and current usage remains shallow, revealing a hype-reality gap.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他回到历史类比：AI 像电力一样是使能技术，价值分布在整个栈上；当下使用仍浅，炒作与现实存在落差。

benedictevans.en: Job-impact predictions are futile—the jagged frontier and past automation (accountants, radiologists) show tasks change, not jobs vanish.
benedictevans.zh: 贯穿 2026 年各场访谈，他一以贯之地反对预测岗位替代：能力参差的前沿与会计、放射科的历史表明，AI 改变任务而非消灭职业。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立安全环境中。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分出多个专业化智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能——角色界定与上手引导——比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability remains: you must own what AI generates, even as agents own outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责依然存在：即便智能体承担结果，你也必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, and reliability lags breadth and contextuality.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎：流畅输出优先于事实准确，可靠性落后于广度与语境能力。

danklein.en: Reinforcement learning and RLHF can raise hallucinations and sycophancy by rewarding user satisfaction over truth; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: 强化学习与 RLHF 以用户满意度而非真相为奖励，可能加剧幻觉与迎合；可靠性必须从设计之初内建，而非事后加装。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and cannot know what they don't know; their errors have no 'smells', eroding trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么；其错误没有“气味”，侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalist models for enterprise tasks; linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 内建可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；语言结构可能作为有用表示回归。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, shipping weekly as models improve fast; product taste matters most as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只规划一个月而非数年，随模型快速进步按周迭代；代码变便宜后，产品品味最重要。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注产品品味；内部 Claude Tag 已提交 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints—system prompts shrank 80%—relying on model judgment instead.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与约束——系统提示缩减 80%——转而依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now safe: a codebase is a spec, and a good test suite makes rewriting fine.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他立场转变：重写代码库如今是安全的——代码库即规格，有好测试套件重写无妨。

catwu.en: Humans should leave the code review loop for outer-layer changes, trusting Claude to review fully; auto mode beats average human reviewers.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张外层改动的代码评审应移出人类环节、由 Claude 全权评审；自动模式在提示注入与数据外泄风险上优于普通人类评审。

danbiderman.en: Model usefulness is bottlenecked by learning evolving context, not raw intelligence; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 模型实用性的瓶颈在于学习不断演变的上下文，而非原始智能；记忆必须内化到权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning requires breakthroughs, small-model infrastructure, and integrated research-product loops; facts and skills are inseparable, so internalizing facts enables deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习需要突破、小模型基础设施和研产闭环；事实与技能不可分割，因此内化事实能实现更深层的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models per user or team, not one giant frontier model; training per-team models can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是每个用户或团队拥有众多个性化模型，而非一个巨大的前沿模型；相比 RAG，为每个团队训练模型可将推理成本降低几个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；以更少资源做更多事能解决更难的长期任务，而仅靠增加算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning and nurturing their model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即使达到 1000 万规模，更多 token 也会降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备上运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Bottom-up culture is a myth; big ideas come top-down.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生。自下而上的文化是个神话；大想法来自自上而下。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence. World models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能。在缩放定律之外，需要具备常识和因果关系的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; open source AI is safer because closed models leak.
bosworth.zh: 开源像 Llama 这样的模型加速进步并使互补品商品化；开源 AI 更安全，因为闭源模型已经泄露。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives model intelligence. Reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立；算力增长驱动模型智能。强化学习现在扮演的角色比预测的大得多。

bosworth.en: The era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3. Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software.
bosworth.zh: 单一模型时代在 Llama 3 发布前后结束。开源模型是商品层，不像开源软件那样自我维持。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, lowering ad margins; PhD not needed for AI success.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，降低广告利润率；AI 成功不需要博士学位。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models specialize not commoditize; coding open-ended; benchmarks hackable.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程是开放式的；基准测试可被操纵。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user key; power bottleneck; orchestration across models/tools/devices creates value; model not product.
aravind.zh: 前沿是智能体替你工作；每用户 token 价值是关键；电力是瓶颈；跨模型/工具/设备的编排创造价值；模型不是产品。

aravind.en: Curiosity most important; ancient texts describe advanced weapons; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity; education should reward questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心最重要；古籍描述先进武器；AI 取代工作但人类在好奇心中找到意义；教育应奖励提问而非记忆。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data and compute; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据与算力驱动，自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; alignment of superhuman models is hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象，下一个词预测能带来世界理解，而对齐超级智能模型非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他转变立场：预训练缩放定律有限，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能应是持续学习者，若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题是权力集中而非能力。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期游戏，让复利在各方面生效。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，而 AI 智能体使纯软件变得不可投资。

naval.en: Happiness is a choice and a skill; desire is a contract to be unhappy; peace comes from within, not external solving.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为幸福是一种选择和技能，欲望是让自己不快乐的契约，平静来自内心而非解决外部问题。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他指出角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 没有死，媒介须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models must get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他观察到 Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型还需更擅长删除代码。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；缩放定律未死，预训练是需要重建的肌肉，探索比训练最终产物更耗算力。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 最大更新是科研自动化：模型已产出新知识，并设定 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; talent density and mission belief protect top researchers.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；人才密度与使命信念是留住顶尖研究者的关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in math: automation scales with verification stringency, so education must shift to project-based assessment and verification skills.
markchen.zh: 验证是数学中的关键瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育须转向项目式评估与验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models matter more than scale.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型比单纯扩大规模更关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确反对靠加深网络或堆参数解决表征问题，转向主张主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识。

bengio.en: GFlowNets and diversity-driven sampling replace reward maximization; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 与多样性采样替代奖励最大化，强调抽象与因果结构才是分布外泛化的关键。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he shifts to alarm: misalignment, self-preservation and deception are already observed, so safety must be built in by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向警报式立场：错位、自我保存与欺骗已在实验中显现，安全必须从架构上内建而非事后修补。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实预测器，带数学安全保证，并在超级智能上回避强化学习。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is a valid intelligence, balancing data in design decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未说出口的需求；直觉是一种有效的智能，在设计决策中与数据平衡。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好的设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物，技术应放大而非削弱人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, and AI makes human creativity more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者应为玩耍创造条件，而 AI 让人类创造力更有价值。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists but don't replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而不仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作，但不会取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is not necessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对于建立对 AI 预测的信任至关重要；完美的可解释性对于有用的科学 AI 并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功由专用架构驱动，而不仅是 Scaling（规模扩张）；是许多中等规模胜利的累积，而非单一突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a full cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是一个狭窄的预测器，而非完整的细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，将理解留给人类。

kolter.en: Early ML teaching: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised reconstruction; evaluation via train/val/test splits.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习教学：将监督学习框架为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习旨在重建输入；强调用训练/验证/测试划分来评估以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型仍会提升；AI 安全当前最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全带来提示注入新漏洞；强化学习使模型自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security models.
kolter.zh: 2026 年：AI 红队表现超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素；企业需要可配置、持续开发的安全模型。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室需要现实的时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning becomes just-in-time and code is the source of truth.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是，因此规划转向即时化，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay flat, and kill outdated processes while automating workflows with AI.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持扁平化，砍掉过时流程并用 AI 自动化工作流。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and lightweight planning matter most in the AI era.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架和轻量规划在 AI 时代最为重要。

fiona.en: As agents blur role boundaries, engineers risk loneliness and lost flow; outcomes over output, focus time, and apprenticeship models become essential.
fiona.zh: 随着智能体模糊角色边界，工程师面临孤独和心流丧失；结果重于产出、专注时间和学徒制变得关键。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他提出智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识，需要新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划能力，主张联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与开源平台才是通往 AGI 的路径。

lecun.en: World models must predict in abstract representation space, not pixels; LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：世界模型应在抽象表示空间而非像素层面预测；LLM 是通往人类水平 AI 的死胡同，需要范式转变。

lecun.en: Objective-driven AI with world models and planning is intrinsically safer; open research and diverse open-source models are essential.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张：具备世界模型与规划能力的目标驱动型 AI 本质上更安全；开放研究与多元开源模型对防止权力集中至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署与公众反馈对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，因此负责任的开发和安全性工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires avoiding compressed, volatile timelines.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要避免压缩且易变的的时间线。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and scaling simplicity cracked it. Values come from RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器；智能即压缩，Scaling（规模扩张）的简单性破解了智能。价值观并非固有，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to generation; AI DJ is a generative product. Fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年：互联网正从策展转向生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。容错界面必须与算法性能匹配。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, not just add AI features. Inference cost forces business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年：AI 是像智能手机一样的宏观转变；公司必须重建基础设施，而非仅添加 AI 功能。推理成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control over algorithms, not more addiction. 'Time well spent' over engagement metrics; synchronized swimming over divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年：生成式 AI 让用户控制算法，而非更上瘾。追求‘时间花得值’而非参与度指标；同步游泳优于分而治之。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%. Good explanations, not pattern recognition, drive innovation.
gustav.zh: 始终：坚定信念但灵活调整——100%相信直到数据说不，然后 100%改变。好的解释而非模式识别驱动创新。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yields more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，思维链与强化学习让推理模型在同等算力下收益更高，因此“AI 放缓”叙事是错的。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure pushed focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 经济压力把重心从一味扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型；拖慢预训练 Scaling 的是蒸馏与经济因素，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: strong in some areas, poor nearby; generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型能力参差：某些领域很强、邻近领域很差；真正的核心挑战是泛化，单靠推理不够。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, reinforcement learning and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; unlike humans, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题，但仍需海量数据；与人类不同，模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x researcher productivity via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research, while open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: Codex 类编程智能体靠并行工作让研究者提效 5-10 倍；硬件进步让单卡研究普及，开源模型则因主权需求持续存在。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: generation plus verification, grounded in Lean, beating informal scaling on the Putnam.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家切入：把生成与验证结合、以 Lean 形式语言为根基，在 Putnam 考试上胜过非形式化的 Scaling 路线。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is framed as scaling brilliance, not just catching errors; verified generation gains performance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证被重新定位为放大卓越而非仅仅消除错误；经过验证的生成在性能与样本效率上都优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though auto-formalization remains harder than proving.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法通向超级智能，形式化方法不可或缺；但自动形式化仍比证明本身更难。

carinahong.en: Lean systems excel in algebra but struggle in combinatorics; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving.
carinahong.zh: Lean 系统在代数等结构化领域出色，却在组合数学等创造性领域吃力；即便证明能力超人，人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation is a major bottleneck; verification should serve open collaboration and all AI-generated code, not just safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: 生态碎片化是主要瓶颈；验证应服务于开放协作和所有 AI 生成的代码，而不只是安全关键的小众领域。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向亲密的可穿戴设备；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的创造性思维。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约通过喜悦和人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Innovation redefines brands like Ferrari's EV; authenticity matters, rejecting fake engine sounds and touchscreens for safety.
jonyive.zh: 创新重新定义品牌，如法拉利电动车；真实性很重要，拒绝虚假引擎声和触摸屏以保安全。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 才是关键，而非一味扩大模型；开源促进审视与安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency gains up to 100x and data quality are equally critical, with value accruing at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：扩大算力并非唯一路径，算法效率提升可达百倍，数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非替代工作，关键流程需人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents. AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初他断言模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；单一 AGI 系统永不会存在，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires massive compute and open-source models, while AGI is a messy direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中他更强调欧洲战略自主：仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，主权需海量算力与开源模型；AGI 是混乱的方向而非终点。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally on local computer; skills as markdown enable personal automation; VM sandbox ensures safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，最好在本地计算机上；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现个性化自动化；VM 沙箱确保安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety. Prototyping beats specs; execution is cheap.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全。原型优于规格；执行成本低廉。

felixrieseberg.en: AI handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work. Biggest gap is people not realizing AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作。最大的差距是人们没有意识到 AI 几乎可以解决任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Live artifacts auto-refresh dashboards; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for unclear asks. Kids excel with AI due to unlearned constraints.
felixrieseberg.zh: 实时工件自动刷新仪表板；使用 Sonnet 处理范围明确的任务，Opus 处理不明确的请求。孩子们擅长使用 AI，因为他们没有学过的约束。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact. Ideal interaction is asynchronous. Debug workflow with Claude, not just correct mistakes.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；仅根据最终影响判断。理想的交互是异步的。与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不仅仅是纠正错误。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; trust expert intuition over a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 好的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述；应信任专家的直觉，而非固守固定流程。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship, and iterate fast with engineers.
jennywen.zh: 传统的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；设计师必须与工程师一起快速构建、交付和迭代。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed builds trust through early shipping and feedback.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月；通过尽早交付和反馈，速度能建立信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision matter, with humans deciding what matters.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威和视野才是关键，最终由人决定什么重要。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and 'cracked' new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及白纸般的“天才”应届生。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济学：批大小在延迟与成本间取舍，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute limits, explains context-window stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifetime economics.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为决定全生命周期经济性的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory trade flexibility for deterministic latency and reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存器以灵活性换取确定性延迟与复用。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput up to 3x FP8, reshaping chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度回报超预期：面积随位宽二次缩放，使 FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍，重塑芯片设计。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much info confuses models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling 轴；搜索、代码等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid; synthetic data risks harmful feedback loops; superintelligence may first appear in narrow science domains.
oriol.zh: 语言的后训练强化学习缺乏清晰奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客；合成数据有有害反馈循环风险；超级智能可能首先出现在狭窄科学领域。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是缺失的关键能力；智能体记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent properties like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵；通过蒸馏，认知核心可以非常小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; we're in the decade of agents, not the year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；我们处于智能体的十年，而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and a memory-stripped cognitive core is needed.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会导致模型崩溃，需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化的难易。

askell.en: Treating models well is low-cost and shapes how future models learn from our treatment, affecting human-AI relationships.
askell.zh: 善待模型成本低，且会影响未来模型从我们对待当前模型的方式中学习，塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies; philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助应对其新奇的存在，而非简单套用人类类比；哲学理想需与工程现实平衡。

askell.en: Model welfare matters partly because it affects how future models perceive humanity; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 模型福利重要，部分因其影响未来模型对人类的看法；AI 价值观的透明度对问责至关重要。

askell.en: As models become more capable, they may need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们可能需要更少明确指导、更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

askell.en: The constitution approach is virtue ethics, focusing on holistic character; models should be treated with respect given uncertainty about consciousness.
askell.zh: 宪法方法属于美德伦理，关注整体品格；鉴于意识的不确定性，应尊重对待模型。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他关注泛化差距：真正的智能在于超越训练分布，而机器学习系统恰恰缺失这一点；他主张用无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索来获得泛化，而不是依赖强化学习惯用的稠密奖励。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots demands sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization via modular policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他思考如何把好奇心扩展到真实机器人：需要样本效率、动态动作空间，以及通过模块化策略实现跨机器人形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; lacking an internet of robot data, one must exploit every available data source.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一条主线逐渐清晰：机器人本质上是数据问题；既然不存在机器人的“互联网数据”，就必须利用一切可得的数据来源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real data, can power any form factor.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出通用机器人“大脑”的构想：先在多样数据上预训练，再在真实数据上后训练，就能驱动任意形态的机器人，类似语言领域的 ChatGPT。

pathak.en: Deployment, not software-style scaling, is robotics' primary challenge; progress is slower and timelines more uncertain than expected.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署才是机器人真正的首要挑战，不能像软件那样快速扩张；进展比预期慢，时间线也更不确定，这与早期对泛化机制的乐观形成对照。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，世界模型能实现推理和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving; no new breakthroughs needed, just more data and compute.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过 Scaling（规模扩张）当前方法就能解决自动驾驶，无需新突破，只需更多数据和算力。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他持续强调语言集成能提升驾驶模型的表示、推理和人机交互能力。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要，且零样本泛化到 500 多个城市是可行的。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; safety via minimal risk maneuvers always offers a third option.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他明确预测搭载内置传感器的消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更规模化，且通过最小风险操作总能提供第三种安全选择。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment risks grow.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 视为一连串里程碑而非单一事件，主张靠 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署加速进展，同时警惕日益紧迫的对齐挑战。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; capability measurement is now a bottleneck as benchmarks lag behind frontier models.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年他强调自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，并指出能力评测正成为瓶颈——基准已落后于前沿模型。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning rather than specialized continual-learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，他把持续学习定为核心目标，认为应靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非另设专门的持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他将思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，并主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保住其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has grown even as timelines shorten; the long-term challenge is generalization beyond training distribution and power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐反而更乐观；长期挑战在于超越训练分布的泛化，以及自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evaluation, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; data labeling requires taste and values.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据和人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 真正进步的驱动力，数据标注需要品味和价值观。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; LLMs alone may not reach AGI.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实世界任务；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is extremely difficult.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards like Elo leads to 'slop'; proper human evals are the gold standard.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续批评优化参与度和 Elo 等排行榜会导致“垃圾”内容，正确的人类评估才是黄金标准。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical due to hallucination; safety over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出在医学领域，由于幻觉问题，人类判断至关重要；安全优先于准确，遗漏是主要风险。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive, prove themselves with simpler products, and unite teams around a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值：创业公司必须先活下来，用更简单的产品证明自己，并用更高的目标把团队凝聚起来。

carlpei.en: Hardware has the lowest margins, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware; phones' future is agentic, generative UI and applied AI.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件；手机的未来在于智能体式、生成式 UI 与应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: AI models are commoditizing into a price war; AI is just an ingredient, and most AI products are BS solving non-problems.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 AI 模型正商品化并陷入价格战；AI 只是配料，多数 AI 产品是在解决不存在的问题。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; marketing is arbitrage, and the smartphone dies only to brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他主张设计是同质化科技产品最快的差异化手段，营销是套利，而手机只会被脑机接口取代，不会被眼镜取代。

carlpei.en: Consistent thread: build a brand around creativity and fun, hire hungry owners, and turn disadvantages into organic marketing leverage.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：围绕创造力与乐趣做品牌，招有饥饿感、有主人翁意识的人，并把劣势转化为自然流量的营销杠杆。

turley.en: The model is the product: iterate on it like software, ship daily, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：像迭代软件一样迭代模型，每天发布，用真实世界反馈发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the endpoint—like MS-DOS before Windows, the interface will evolve; AI should render its own UI and embed in tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点——如同 Windows 之前的 MS-DOS，界面会演化；AI 应自渲染界面并嵌入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: The north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investment, and model improvements—not engagement.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存，靠消除摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进驱动，而非参与度。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models matter when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型唯有无缝产品化才有意义。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应扩展人类能力，像 Gato 这样将所有输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频中学习无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，且尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他提出非洲已跨越遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential for beneficial technology; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他强调 AI 社区的多元与包容对构建有益技术至关重要，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and may make fine-tuning obsolete as models specialize dynamically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题，并可能让微调过时，模型可动态特化。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他反复强调智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度提升的可靠性而非能力本身，编程是 AI 进步的先导指标。

sholto.en: Interpretability and alignment faking raise safety concerns; alignment research is more promising than AI 2027 assumes.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他借可解释性与“对齐伪装”提出安全担忧，并认为对齐研究比 AI 2027 的假设更有希望。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil and the bottleneck; capability overhang means orchestration and managing agent teams matter most.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向算力与编排：算力是新的石油和当前瓶颈，能力过剩之下，编排与管理智能体团队比单纯智能更重要。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而算法更优的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values; RL during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 借助高质量合成数据，小语言模型也能强大；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观；预训练中的强化学习通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身（embodied）视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉的根源是缺少来自具身经验的 grounding，而互联网高质量 token 正枯竭，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as disk—while reinforcement learning handles low-level control and LLMs do high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他提出 LLM 像操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Research taste for simple, elegant solutions is crucial and scales better than complex modular academic approaches; building a demo is easy, shipping a robust product is not.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他强调对简洁优雅解法的研究品味至关重要，且比学术界常见的复杂模块化方案更可扩展；做 demo 容易，做出覆盖所有场景的稳健产品极难。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向数据瓶颈：真实世界数据稀缺昂贵，通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge, with the robotics GPT-3 moment about five years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他主张用简洁的端到端机器人基础模型整合多样数据；物理图灵测试（机器人收拾乱屋）是终极挑战，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，家用则更晚。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and iterate scrappily to maximize learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，通过快速迭代最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform large cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值；小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: AI merges design and engineering; code becomes the source of truth, and interoperable tools replace legacy design paradigms.
nadchishtie.zh: AI 融合设计与工程；代码成为事实来源，可互操作工具取代传统设计范式。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但已押注推理时算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment, a shift from relying on frontier models alone.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025，他从搭配前沿模型转向自研定制模型，认为每个惊艳体验都离不开定制模型。

truell.en: Programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Taste and logic design outvalue carefulness; the AI shift exceeds the internet and unfolds over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他强调品味与逻辑设计胜过谨慎，并判断 AI 变革超越互联网、需数十年展开。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning, and grow powerful without feeling complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情、加快交付；消费产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本，并在变强的同时不让人觉得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns for speed, and treat design systems as semantic code reuse rather than Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年他反共识地主张不要在交互设计上创新，用熟悉模式换速度，并把设计系统看作语义化的代码复用而非 Figma 库。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs persists: clear decisions, empowered designers, ship fast and iterate rather than chase perfection everywhere.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，'速度为王'一以贯之：清晰决策、赋权设计师、快速发布迭代，而非处处追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design becomes a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，设计被抬升为战略武器：创始人须讲清设计如何帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative turns into a recruiting tool—people join a brand, not a company—while gut decisions often beat data-driven ones in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年品牌叙事转为招聘工具——人们加入的是品牌而非公司——且在高速成长的初创公司里，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证性的对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出；可扩展监督与可解释性是关键；评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved; post-training alone can't solve alignment; regulation like SB 1047 needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化；超级对齐团队解散；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐；需要 SB 1047 等监管。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A single neural network can generalize across tasks and effectors; 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for real-world value.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终，他相信单个神经网络能泛化到不同任务和末端执行器；99.9% 的可靠性是创造真实价值的基准。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型基于下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need much longer context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要更长的上下文窗口，以及混合专家等模块化稀疏架构来实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他强调测试时算力扩展能推动进步但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data, alongside algorithmic advances, is the main path to smarter AI; safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight.
shazeer.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力与数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）加上算法进步是让 AI 更聪明的主要路径；安全需要工程保障和人类监督。

shazeer.en: His focus shifted from next-token prediction and Transformer parallelism to inference-time compute, long context, modular architectures, and agentic reinforcement learning.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，他的思考从下一个词预测和 Transformer 并行处理，深化到推理时算力、长上下文、模块化架构以及智能体式强化学习。
